gem_guidance.text: It's important to note that the epic gems arrive in this phase, so plan accordingly. Regarding meta gems, depending on your play-style, you'll want to either use Bracing Earthstorm Diamond and stack +healing gems or use Insightful Earthstorm Diamond and the appropriate gems to ensure meta activation.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Holy Paladin Healing Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 4 Gear Guide - Wowhead
